blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce Index-Translate, a multilingual translation model family that combines a shared multilingual foundation with specialized training for general translation, instruction following, speech translation, controlled dubbing, and long-document translation. It includes three model sizes, 2B, 9B, and 35B-A3B, and supports translation in 150 languages, with multilingual instruction following. Evaluations on general translation and complex translation instructions show that Index-Translate outperforms translation models of comparable size and achieves performance comparable to 100B-scale translation models and frontier models. Index-Echo provides end-to-end speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation, outperforming existing end-to-end models and achieving performance comparable to frontier omni models. Index-Homura extends the family to syllable-controlled dubbing. Index-NativeLong introduces native long-document translation with a dedicated task formulation and benchmark. These capabilities support diverse translation tasks, including multilingual content production.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了索引翻译系统,这是一个多语种翻译模式家庭,它将一个共同的多语种基础与一般翻译、后续教学、语音翻译、有控制的调侃和长文件翻译的专门培训结合起来。 它包括3个模型大小,2B,9B和35B-A3B,并支持150种语言的翻译,后面是多语种教学. 对一般翻译和复杂翻译指令的评价表明,索引翻译超越了可比较大小的翻译模型,实现了与100B级翻译模型和前沿模型相当的性能. Index-Echo提供端到端的语音对文本和语音对语音的翻译,优于现有的端到端模型,并实现与前沿的omni模型相媲美的性能. Index-Homura将家族扩展为音节控制的配音. Index-NativeLong推出本土长文件翻译,并附有专门的任务设置和基准. 这些能力支持多种翻译任务,包括多语种内容制作.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multilingual translation models must preserve meaning across languages while accommodating differences in task requirements, input and output modalities, and context length. Index-Translate addresses these needs as a model family built on a shared multilingual foundation.
blocks.zh: 多语种翻译模式必须保留不同语言的含义,同时顾及任务要求、投入和产出模式以及上下文长度的差异。 Index-Translate作为建立在共同多语种基础上的模范家庭来解决这些需求。

blocks.en: Content production provides concrete examples of these requirements. Structured documents must preserve fields and terminology; community expressions require cultural interpretation; dubbed utterances must fit a target length; and books must maintain identities across distant passages. Speech translation adds acoustic understanding and spoken output.
blocks.zh: 内容制作提供了这些要求的具体实例。 结构化的文件必须保留字段和术语;社区表达需要文化解释;被誉的言论必须符合目标长度;书籍必须跨越遥远的段落保持身份。 语音翻译增加了声学理解和口语输出.

blocks.en: Our central question is which of these capabilities compact translation models can share and consolidate, and which benefit from dedicated training or output interfaces. Starting from Qwen3.5 base models [ 1 ] , Index-Translate addresses this question through three connected design choices: • A shared multilingual foundation. We combine general, monolingual, parallel, and pivot-organized text to build a translation foundation for 150 languages, studying how language coverage and data organization affect translation quality and general capability retention. • Integration of complementary translation skills. General, instruction-following, and meme experts use task-specific SFT and RL, with adversarial supervision for judge-based rewards. Parameter interpolation combines these experts, followed by targeted multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) for tasks that remain weak after merging. • Dedicated training for speech, length control, and long documents. Index-Echo connects the text foundation to speech perception and generation; Index-Homura learns explicit syllable control; and Index-NativeLong addresses native long-document translation with a dedicated task formulation and benchmark. These adaptations address different input, output, and sequence-length requirements. Our analyses examine both gains and limits of capability sharing. Broader language coverage improves non-core translation, while expert integration exposes trade-offs among quality, instruction adherence, and cultural adaptation. Precise syllable control transfers poorly through the studied merging and distillation settings, motivating a dedicated specialist. Table 1 summarizes the model family; Appendix C lists the supported languages and their identifiers.
blocks.zh: 我们的中心问题是,这些能力中哪些是可共享和合并的紧凑翻译模式,哪些是受益于专门的培训或产出接口。 从Quen3.5基本模型[1]开始,Index-Translate通过三个相互关联的设计选择来解决这个问题: • 一个共同的多语种基础. 我们把一般的、单一的、平行的和中枢的文本结合起来,为150种语言建立一个翻译基础,研究语言覆盖面和数据组织如何影响翻译质量和一般能力保留。 • 整合辅助翻译技能。 一般的、遵循指示的和meme专家使用特定任务的SFT和RL,对基于法官的奖励实行对抗性监督。 参数插值结合了这些专家,然后针对合并后仍很薄弱的任务进行有针对性的多教师政策提炼。 • 对发言、长度控制和长文件进行专门培训。 Index-Echo将文本基础与语音感知和生成连接起来;Index-Homura学习明确的音节控制;Index-NativeLong用专门的任务制定和基准处理本地长文件翻译. 这些修改涉及不同的输入、输出和序列长度要求。 我们的分析研究了分享能力的收益和局限。 更广泛的语言覆盖面改善了非核心翻译,而专家融合则揭示了质量、遵守教学和文化适应之间的权衡。 通过研究的合并和蒸馏设置,精确的音节控制转移不佳,激励了一位专职专家。 表1概括了模式家族;附录C列出了所支持的语言及其识别特征.

blocks.en: 2.1 Multilingual mid-training
blocks.zh: 2.1 多语种中级培训

blocks.en: Mid-training improves cross-language alignment while retaining broad linguistic competence. We combine general pre-training replay, independently sampled monolingual text, and parallel translations.
blocks.zh: 中级培训在保留广泛的语言能力的同时改进了跨语言的配合。 我们结合了一般的训练前重播,独立抽取的单语文字,以及平行的翻译.

blocks.en: Aligning the same content across languages can improve multilingual consistency and performance [ 2 ] . We distinguish ordinary parallel text ( P P ) from pivot-organized text ( V V ). In the Qwen3-8B pilot, ordinary parallel examples align two languages directly, while pivot groups connect multiple language variants through an English anchor. Parallel degree counts the languages aligned to the same content; data-stream weights determine how often each construction is sampled.
blocks.zh: 统一各语文的相同内容可以提高多语种的一致性和性能[2]. 我们把普通平行文本(PP)与主要组织文本(VV)区分开来。 在Qwen3-8B试点中,普通的平行例子直接对齐两种语言,而枢轴组通过英语锚连接多种语言变体. 平行程度计算与相同内容一致的语言;数据流权重决定每个构造的采样频率.

blocks.en: The final recipe uses separate pivot streams for core and full language coverage. The stream labels pivot-20 and pivot-148 in Table 2 exclude English and Chinese from their counts; including these two languages gives 22 core and 150 total entries in Appendix C . Ordinary parallel text enters the constant stage with general and monolingual text; pivot data dominate decay. Appendix A.1 illustrates the two organizations.
blocks.zh: 最后的食谱使用单独的枢轴流进行核心和全语言覆盖. 表2中的溪流标签pivot-20和pivot-148将英语和汉语排除在计数之外;包括这两种语言在内,附录C中共有22个核心条目和150个条目。 普通平行文本以普通文本和单一语言文本进入常态阶段;枢轴数据主导衰变. 附录A.1说明了这两个组织的情况。

blocks.en: The shared 2B, 9B, and 35B-A3B recipe follows the stable and decay phases of the warmup–stable–decay schedule [ 3 ] . We use AdamW, a sequence length of 4,096, a global batch of 4,096 sequences, and a micro-batch of 128. Table 2 gives the stage mixtures, learning rates, and token budgets. The long-document extension increases sequence length during decay (Section 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 2.2 Post-training
blocks.zh: 2.2 培训后

blocks.en: We develop general translation, instruction-following, and meme-translation experts through a shared SFT-to-RL workflow. Each expert uses task-specific data and supervision; Section 2.3 describes how we combine their complementary capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个共享的SFT到RL工作流程,培养一般翻译,指令跟踪和meme翻译专家. 每个专家都使用特定任务的数据和监督;第2.3节描述了我们如何将互补能力结合起来。

blocks.en: General translation SFT uses multilingual training data with translations regenerated by frontier models and filtered for language consistency and quality, retaining both core and low-resource directions. Instruction SFT uses 1.045 million examples across ten real-world scenarios, with constraints on structure, terminology, context, and style. It mixes instruction translation and general-capability data at a 1 : 1 1{:}1 token ratio. Meme SFT adds curated examples that teach the model to resolve nonliteral meanings and preserve pragmatic intent through idiomatic paraphrase, explanation, or cultural adaptation.
blocks.zh: 通用翻译SFT使用多语种培训数据,由前沿模型重新生成翻译,并过滤语言一致性和质量,保留核心方向和低资源方向. 指令SFT在十种现实世界情景中使用了104.5万例,对结构,名词,上下文,风格都有限制. 它将指令翻译和一般能力数据混合在一个:1:1{}1符比. Meme SFT增加了一些经过整理的例子,这些例子教该模型通过平庸的释义、解释或文化适应,解决非文学意义并保持务实的意图。

blocks.en: Meme RL uses a reference-guided LLM judge to assess contextual meaning, cultural function, and pragmatic effect.
blocks.zh: Meme RL使用一个参考指南LLM法官来评估背景含义,文化功能,以及实用效果.

blocks.en: We supplement judge-based rewards with our RIVAL framework [ 4 ] . Training alternates reward-model updates on current policy outputs with policy optimization against the refreshed reward. Preference ranking, auxiliary quantitative supervision, and replay of earlier outputs help the evaluator track evolving failure patterns. In our earlier Qwen2.5-7B study [ 4 ] , subtitle quality judged by GPT-4o rose from 3.26 to 3.68 between RIVAL iterations 0 and 1; training-curve analysis also showed reduced divergence between reward-model and external evaluations. At iteration 2 on WMT English-to-Chinese, adding quantitative supervision to preference ranking improved BLEU from 30.14 to 39.39 and COMETKiwi from 71.91 to 72.60. These results motivate using adaptive reward supervision to mitigate reward hacking. Appendix B.5 gives representative cases from Index-Translate training.
blocks.zh: 我们用我们的RIVAL框架来补充以法官为基础的奖励。 培训替代奖励模式,更新现行政策产出,并对照刷新奖励优化政策。 优先排序、辅助量化监督和重现先前的产出有助于评价人员跟踪不断演变的失败模式。 在我们早先的Quen2.5-7B研究[4]中,GPT-4o判断的副标题质量在RIVAL迭代0和1之间从3.26升至3.68;培训曲线分析也显示奖励模式与外部评价之间的差别有所缩小. 在WMT英文对中文的重复2中,在优惠排名中增加了定量监督,改进了BLEU从30.14到39.39,以及COMETKiwi从71.91到72.60. 这些结果激励人们利用适应性的奖励监督来缓解奖励黑客行为. 附录B.5提供了索引翻译培训中的代表性案例。

blocks.en: 3 Model Extensions
blocks.zh: 3 模式扩展

blocks.en: 3.1 Index-Echo: speech translation
blocks.zh: 3.1 索引-Echo:语音翻译

blocks.en: Index-Echo connects a Qwen3-Omni AuT audio encoder [ 7 ] and connector to an Index-Translate 2B or 9B decoder. We train the resulting model end to end on speech translation, combining acoustic input, target-language instructions, and translated text in one sequence. This design uses the multilingual text model as the translation component while learning to interpret the source directly from audio.
blocks.zh: Index-Echo将一个Qune3-Omni AuT音频编码器[7]和连接器连接到一个Index-Translate 2B或9B解码器. 我们训练所形成的模型结束 在语音翻译上, 结合声学输入,目标语言说明, 和翻译文本 一个顺序。 这种设计在学习直接从音频解释源时,使用多语言文本模型作为翻译组件.

blocks.en: We initialize S2ST training from the trained 2B and 9B S2TT models. The speech-generation path replaces the CosyVoice3 [ 8 ] text-tokenizer interface with a roughly 30M-parameter Hidden2CV mapper from the translator’s final hidden states to the semantic layer. We first distill the mapper with the S2TT backbone and speech generator frozen. The S2TT backbone remains frozen during subsequent differentiable reward optimization (DiffRO). Following CosyVoice3 [ 8 ] , DiffRO backpropagates a Token2Text content-consistency reward through Gumbel-Softmax speech-token samples. Source audio supplies a reference prompt and CampPlus speaker embedding for voice conditioning.
blocks.zh: 我们从经过训练的2B型和9B型S2TT型开始S2ST训练. 语音生成路径将 CosyVoice3 [8] 文本切换器接口替换为大约30M-参数 Hide2CV 映射器,从翻译器的最终隐藏状态到语义层. 我们先用S2TT骨干和语音生成器 来蒸馏映射器 S2TT主干在后续的可分奖励优化(DiffRO)期间仍然被冻结. 继CosyVoice3 [8] 之后, DiffRO通过 Gumbel-Softmax 语音调试样本, 背传了一个 Token2Text 内容一致性奖励 。 源音频提供参考提示和CampPlus扬声器,用于语音调制。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Index-Echo speech-to-text and speech-to-speech architecture. S2ST training aligns the mapper and then applies DiffRO; the S2TT backbone remains frozen throughout.
blocks.zh: 图3 索引-Echo语音对文本和语音对语音架构. S2ST训练对映射器进行对齐,然后应用DiffRO;S2TT主干线在整个过程中仍然保持冻结.

blocks.en: The resulting S2ST models cover six translation directions: Chinese to English, Spanish, and Japanese, and English to Chinese, Spanish, and Japanese. The target language is specified explicitly, and source audio provides voice conditioning.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的S2ST模型包括六个翻译方向:中文到英文,西班牙文和日文,英文到中文,西班牙文和日文. 目标语言被明确指定,源音频提供语音条件.

blocks.en: 3.2 Index-Homura: translation for dubbing
blocks.zh: 3.2 Index-Homura:用于欺骗的翻译

blocks.en: Index-Homura adapts the 2B and 9B text models to translation with an explicitly specified target syllable count. Given a source text and a target count s ⋆ s^{\star} , the model adjusts its wording to meet the requested count while preserving meaning and natural expression.
blocks.zh: Index-Homura将2B和9B的文本模型修改为带有明确指定的目标音节计数的翻译. 鉴于一个源文本和一个目标计数s QQ s^{\star},该模型在保留意义和自然表达的同时,调整其措辞以满足请求的计数.

blocks.en: Building on the reinforcement-learning approach of HOMURA [ 9 ] , we use GRPO to jointly optimize translation quality and adherence to the specified syllable count. The length reward measures how closely the generated translation matches s ⋆ s^{\star} , enabling direct control over the syllable count of the output.
blocks.zh: 在HOMURA[9]的强化学习方法的基础上,我们利用GRPO共同优化翻译质量和遵守规定的音节计数. 长度奖励衡量生成的翻译与 s QQ s^{\star 的匹配程度, 从而可以直接控制输出的音节计数 。

blocks.en: 3.3 Index-NativeLong: native long-document translation
blocks.zh: 3.3 Index-NativeLong:本地长文件翻译

blocks.en: Book translation requires faithful coverage and continuity across distant passages. We study native long-document translation , in which a model receives the full source document and produces its complete translation in a single generation. Index-NativeLong extends our multilingual text foundation to this task, combining long-context understanding with sustained output [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 书籍翻译需要忠实的覆盖和跨越遥远段落的连续性。 我们研究本土的长文件翻译,其中一个模型接收完整的源文件,并在一代人中产生完整的翻译. Index-NativeLong将我们的多语种文本基础延伸至这项任务,将长文本理解与持续产出相结合[12].

blocks.en: Glossary-assisted frameworks such as TranslateBooksWithLLMs [ 28 ] connect chunks through terminology lists and neighboring context, but can still lose conceptual distinctions and document-wide consistency. In our glacial-history case, 9B preserves the distinction between an ice age ( \chinesefont 冰河时代) and its glacials ( \chinesefont 冰期), while chunked Qwen3.8-Flash conflates them even with a full-source glossary. For recurring names such as \chinesefont 王妃 and Zeitlin, native 9B maintains consistent translations where the same model with glossary-assisted chunking changes them. Appendix B.4 gives the original excerpts and comparison settings.
blocks.zh: 词汇辅助框架,如TranslateBooksWindLLMs[28]通过名词列表和相邻上下文连接块,但仍可失去概念区分和全文件的一致性. 在我们的冰川-历史案例中,9B保留了冰河时代(\chinesfont QX)与其冰川的区别(\chinesfont QX),而块状的Qwen3.8-Flash甚至用一个全源词汇来拼凑它们. 对于 \ chinesefont QQ 和 Zeitlin 等反复出现的名称, 本地 9B 保留一致的翻译, 使用 词汇 辅助块 的同一模型可以更改它们 。 附录B.4给出了原始摘录和比较设置.

blocks.en: Native generation keeps the full source and translation history together, supporting these document-level requirements without separate glossary preparation or repeated context input. We introduce NativeLongBench to evaluate this capability; Section 4.6 presents the data and results.
blocks.zh: 原生代保持了完整的源和翻译历史,支持这些文档级别的要求,不单独编写词汇表或重复上下文输入. 我们采用土著Long Bench来评价这一能力;第4.6节介绍了数据和结果。

blocks.en: We adapt the 2B and 9B models through full-parameter SFT on aligned book passages and complete target translations. The 2B model follows 128K-sequence mid-training decay and general SFT; the 9B model continues from the integrated model in Section 2.3 . Both receive bidirectional document supervision over approximately 4K–64K Chinese-side tokens. GuoFeng ablations support long-sequence decay and show comparable overall quality for RoPE and NoPE after long-document SFT (Appendix A.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们通过全参数的SFT来调整2B和9B模型在对齐的书籍段落和完成目标翻译. 2B型机车采用128K-序列的中训衰变和通用SFT;9B型机车继续使用2.3节的集成型机车. 两人均接受约4K–64K中方代币的双向文件监督. GuoFeng bloods支持长序衰变,并在长文件SFT(Appendix A.3 )之后显示RoPE和NoPE的可比整体质量.

blocks.en: We introduce instTrans to evaluate translation under task-specific instructions across subtitles, social content, articles, academic documents, books, and fiction. The evaluated core set contains 3,000 examples from Chinese to 20 target languages; a low-resource extension adds 2,793 examples from Chinese or English to low-resource languages. The benchmark covers ten constraint types, comprising five hard checks and five graded soft constraints. These include format and terminology preservation, subtitle syllable alignment, style consistency, cross-sentence terminology, coreference resolution, and context disambiguation. Multiple constraints can apply to the same example.
blocks.zh: 我们推出InstTrans, 以评价字幕、社会内容、文章、学术文件、书籍和小说等具体任务说明下的翻译。 评估的核心集包含从中文到20种目标语言的3,000个实例;一个低资源扩展增加了从中文或英文到低资源语言的2,793个实例. 基准包括10种制约类型,包括5种硬检查和5种等级软约束. 其中包括格式和名词保存,字幕音节对齐,风格一致,跨句式名词,coreference分辨率,以及上下文混淆. 多重制约可适用于同一例子。

blocks.en: We report translation quality and IFscore separately. Quality uses three GPT-5.6-Sol judge calls per example on a 0/0.5/1 scale. IFscore gates the mean soft-constraint score by hard-constraint checks, assigning zero if any required hard check fails, then averages over examples. Valid quality judgments cover 2,961 / 2,960 core examples and 2,777 / 2,776 low-resource examples for 2B / 9B; means use valid judgments. Table 20 breaks down selected constraints, and Appendix B provides representative translation cases.
blocks.zh: 我们分别报告翻译质量和IFscount。 质量使用3个GPT-5.6-Sol法官以0/0.5/1比例调用每个例. IFscore通过硬约束检查将平均软约束分数闸门打开,如果需要任何硬检查失败,则指定为零,然后将平均值凌驾于示例之上。 有效质量判决包括2,961 / 2,960个核心实例,2B / 9B 的2,777 / 2,776个低资源实例;意味着使用有效的判决. 表20列出了某些制约因素,附录B提供了有代表性的翻译案例。

blocks.en: MEME evaluates Chinese-to-English translation of culturally marked user-generated content, with 3,638 cases covering 703 terms and 857 disambiguated senses. Community experts validate sense assignments, and bilingual experts annotate translation strategies and quality-tiered references. Gemini-2.5-Flash receives each term’s definition, usage examples, and references, assigning 1 for an accurate and idiomatic translation, 0.5 for a flawed but usable translation, and 0 for an unusable translation. Appendix B.2 illustrates how the models recover playful spellings, community aliases, and laughter expressions.
blocks.zh: MEME评价文化标志用户生成内容的中文对英文翻译,3,638个案例,涵盖703个词汇和857个离散感. 社区专家验证了感官任务,双语专家对翻译战略和质量级参考进行了注释。 双子座2.5-Flash收到每个术语的定义、用法实例和参考文献,指定1个用于准确和平庸的翻译,0.5个用于有缺陷但有用的翻译,0个用于无法使用的翻译。 附录B.2说明了模型如何恢复游戏拼音、社区别名和笑声表达方式。

blocks.en: 4.3 General capabilities
blocks.zh: 4.3 一般能力

blocks.en: We evaluate general knowledge and multilingual question answering with C-Eval [ 19 ] , GPQA-Diamond [ 20 ] , INCLUDE [ 21 ] , and MMMLU [ 22 ] . All models use the same evaluated subsets: 12,342 labeled C-Eval test questions across 52 subjects, 198 GPQA-Diamond questions, 22,639 INCLUDE questions in 44 languages, and 4,200 MMMLU questions sampled as 300 per language across 14 languages (seed 42). Scores are answer accuracy, with sample-level averaging for the multilingual sets.
blocks.zh: 我们用C-Eval[19]、GPQA-Diamond[20]、INCLUDE[21]和MMMLU[22]来评价一般知识和多语种问题回答。 所有模型都使用相同的评价子集:12 342个标签 C-Eval测试问题涉及52个学科,198个GPQA-Diamond问题,22,639个INCLUDE问题涉及44种语言,4,200个MMMLU问题在14种语言中被抽样为每种语言300个(种子42). 分数是答题精度,多语种集的样本水平平均.

blocks.en: 4.4 Speech translation
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 语音翻译

blocks.en: The in-house video translation set contains 140 windows of 50–60 seconds, with 20 per direction: Chinese to English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, and Arabic, plus English to Chinese. MT judge averages Gemini-3.1-Pro’s per-line translation quality ratings on a 0/0.5/1 scale. ASR error is the median error rate between the model’s transcription of the source audio and the reference transcript. Timestamp MAE is the mean absolute difference, in seconds, between predicted and reference sentence start times.
blocks.zh: 内部的视频翻译集包含140个窗口,50–60秒,每个方向有20个:中文对英语,日语,韩语,西班牙语,葡萄牙语和阿拉伯语,加上英文对中文. MT评委平均双子座3.1-Pro的每行翻译质量评分为0/0.5/1分. ASR错误是模型对源音频的转录与参考记录的中间错误率. 时间戳 MAE是预测和参考句起始时间之间的平均绝对差数,以秒计.

blocks.en: Index-Echo-2B and 9B achieve the two lowest ASR and timestamp errors (Table 7 ). The 9B translation score is 0.857, between Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash and Gemini-3.1-Pro with thinking. Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate is evaluated in streaming mode.
blocks.zh: Index-Echo-2B和9B实现两个最低的ASR和时间戳错误(表7)。 9B的翻译得分为0.857,介于Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash和双子座3.1-Pro之间与思考. Qune3.8-LiveTranslate在流派模式下进行评估.

blocks.en: Table 7: S2TT comparison on the in-house video translation test set. Dashes denote unavailable timestamp outputs. SeamlessM4T-v2 lacks line-level timestamp instructions and receives unchunked approximately 57-second inputs, beyond its approximately 30-second effective range.
blocks.zh: 表7:S2TT与内部视频翻译测试集的比较. 数字表示没有时间戳的产出。 无缝M4T-v2缺乏线级时间戳指示,接收到约57秒的未充电输入,超过其约30秒有效范围.

blocks.en: We compare E2E dubbing with Index-Echo-S2TT + CosyVoice3 on in-house video dubbing data across six directions and two model sizes (Table 8 ). Each pair shares the same frozen Index-Echo-S2TT model and text translation, judged by Gemini-3.1-Pro. Chinese-source tests contain 100 examples for English and 200 each for Spanish and Japanese. English-source tests contain 200 examples each for Chinese, Spanish, and Japanese, with 146–198 retained after filtering. Content error is reported as mean / median, using WER for English and Spanish, normalized CER for Chinese, and katakana CER for Japanese. Speaker similarity is cosine similarity against the source speaker.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了E2E dubbing与Index-Echo-S2TT + CosyVoice3在内部视频中跨6个方向和两个模型大小的dibbing数据(表8). 每对都共享相同的冷冻索引-Echo-S2TT模型和文本翻译,由双子座3.1-Pro判断. 中文源测试包含100个英文实例,200个西班牙文和日文实例. 英文源测试中,中文,西班牙文,日文各包含200例,过滤后保留146–198例. 内容错误作为平均值/中值报告,英文和西班牙文使用WER,中文使用普通CER,日文使用katakana CER. 议长的相似性是同位素对源发言人的相似性.

blocks.en: E2E lowers mean content error in 8 of 12 size–direction pairs; Chinese-to-English favors the pipeline. Speaker similarity differences are small, with a 0.021 E2E gain for Chinese-to-English and absolute differences within 0.01 elsewhere. In an earlier Chinese-source evaluation, Index-Echo-2B also exceeds SeamlessM4T-v2 in MT judge score: 0.905 versus 0.370 for English, 0.823 versus 0.343 for Spanish, and 0.838 versus 0.310 for Japanese.
blocks.zh: E2E更低意味着12个尺寸的8个方向对的内容错误;中英对输油管的偏好. 议长的相似性差异很小,中英之间有0.021 E2E增益,在其他地方0.01范围内绝对差异. 在较早的一次中国来源评价中,Index-Echo-2B也超过了 MT裁判的无缝M4T-v2得分:英语0.905对0.370,西班牙语0.823对0.343,日语0.838对0.310.

blocks.en: Table 8: Matched S2ST comparison on in-house video dubbing test data at 2B and 9B. Pipeline denotes Index-Echo-S2TT + CosyVoice3. Both systems share the same frozen Index-Echo-S2TT model and text translation. Bold marks the lower mean content error within each row. Spk. is source-speaker cosine similarity.
blocks.zh: 表8:2B和9B对内部视频配音测试数据的S2ST对比. 管道表示索引-Echo-S2TT + CosyVoice3. 这两个系统都拥有相同的冻结索引-Echo-S2TT模型和文本翻译. 粗体标记每行中较低的平均内容错误。 Spk. 是源语言的余弦相似性.

blocks.en: 4.5 Syllable-controlled translation
blocks.zh: 4.5 可符号控制翻译

blocks.en: SandGlass contains 300 subtitle sentences, with 60 each from animation, film and television, travel, gaming, and knowledge, and at most ten per video. Four target languages and three target syllable counts yield 3,600 cases per model. Central counts multiply subtitle duration by speaking rates of 6.19/7.84/7.82/8.4 syllables per second for English/Japanese/Spanish/Arabic; short and long targets scale these by 0.75 and 1.25. Local models use greedy decoding with a 512-token output limit; API baselines use their recorded settings. Gemini-2.5-Flash judges quality without a reference on a 0/0.5/1 scale, with the length constraint in the prompt. We report relative syllable deviation, rates within one syllable or 10% of the target, and output-versus-target regression slope across 1,200 three-budget groups (ideal: 1).
blocks.zh: SandGlass包含300个字幕句,每句60个来自动画,电影和电视,旅行,游戏,以及知识,每个视频最多10个. 4种目标语言和3种目标音节计数,每个模型得出3 600个案例。 中央计数乘以6.19/7.84/7.82/8.4的发言率 英语/日语/西班牙语/阿拉伯语的音节每秒;短而长的目标比例为0.75和1.25。 本地模型使用有512个托肯输出限制的贪婪解码;API基线使用其记录的设置. 双子座-2.5-Flash评委在0/0.5/1尺度上没有参考质量,长度限制在即. 我们报告相对的音节偏差、一个音节内的比率或指标的10%,以及1 200个三个预算组的产出与目标回归坡度(理想:1)。

blocks.en: Index-Homura-9B and 2B achieve within-10% rates of 81.92% and 63.08%, exceeding the external baselines while reducing mean deviation (Table 9 ). DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GPT-5.6-Sol score higher on translation quality. Table 10 gives the language breakdown; Section 5.3 examines the quality–control trade-off. Appendix B.3 illustrates responses to different target counts.
blocks.zh: Index-Homura-9B和2B在10%内达到81.92%和63.08%,超过了外部基线,同时减少了平均偏差(表9)。 DeepSeek-V4-Flash和GPT-5.6-Sol在翻译质量上得分较高. 表10列出语文细目;第5.3节审查了质量控制权衡。 附录B.3说明了对不同目标数的反应。

blocks.en: Table 9: Expanded SandGlass evaluation on 3,600 cases per model. d d is relative syllable-count deviation. Bold marks the best value among the displayed models (slope closest to 1). GPT-5.6-Sol uses the recorded gateway configuration, which may inject additional system prompts.
blocks.zh: 表9:每个模型对3 600个病例的扩大的沙岩评估。 dd是相对的音节计算偏差。 粗体标记显示的模型中的最佳值(最接近1的斜坡). GPT-5.6-Sol使用记录的网关配置,这可能会注入额外的系统提示.

blocks.en: Table 10: Index-Homura-9B by target language on SandGlass. Each language includes 300 sentences at three length targets.
blocks.zh: 表10:SandGlass上按目标语言分列的索引-Homura-9B. 每种语言包括300句,分三个长度目标.

blocks.en: 4.6 Native long-document translation
blocks.zh: 4.6 原生长文件翻译

blocks.en: NativeLongBench evaluates native long-document translation on GuoFeng [ 16 ] , BWB [ 23 ] , and General Books. We select and align bilingual book material from these corpora. GuoFeng and BWB contain web fiction originally written in Chinese, with English translations. General Books adds English originals across literature, history, social science, science and technology, paired with model-generated Chinese translations. We preserve chapter order, align bilingual passages, and filter incomplete or mismatched pairs. Table 11 summarizes the books used in this study. Japanese originals paired with model-generated Chinese translations provide additional training supervision.
blocks.zh: 原住民Long Bench评价土著长文件译本在郭芬[16],BWB[23],以及通典. 我们从这些公司中挑选和整理双语书籍材料。 郭芬和BWB包含最初用中文写的网络小说,有英文翻译. "通典"增加了跨越文学,历史,社会科学,科学技术的英文原著,与模型生成的中文译本对齐. 我们保留章节顺序,对齐双语段落,过滤不完整或不匹配的对子. 表11总结了本研究报告所用的书籍。 日文原版与模型生成的中文译本配对,提供额外的训练监督.

blocks.en: All three corpora are divided by work into training, validation, and test sets. GuoFeng test works are selected from its public training corpus because the official test set is not public. We also exclude identified copies of test works in other corpora from training. The benchmark draws continuous passages from held-out books, evaluating Chinese to English on GuoFeng/BWB and English to Chinese on General Books. This GuoFeng evaluation is distinct from the chapter-level test in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 全部三只蝎子都按工作划分为训练,验证,测试组. 郭芬试题作品选自其公开训练馆,因为官方试题集不公开. 我们还将其他公司测试作品的鉴定副本排除在培训之外。 该基准从被搁置的书籍中吸取连续段落,在GuoFeng/BWB上评价中文改为英文,在普通书籍上评价英文改为中文。 本郭风评价与表3中的章节级测试不同.

blocks.en: Table 11: Books used in this study. Lengths describe the available original-language text per training book (K = 1,024 tokens); P25–P75 denotes the middle 50% of the length distribution.
blocks.zh: 表11:本研究使用的书籍. 长度描述每本训练册可用的原文文本(K=1,024令牌);P25-P75表示长度分布的中间50%.

blocks.en: We plan to make the shareable portions of NativeLongBench publicly available.
blocks.zh: 我们计划公开分享土著Long Bench的部分。

blocks.en: The main comparison evaluates all models in the native setting: each receives the complete test document and is asked to translate it in a single generation. All test length groups use Chinese-side token counts: Chinese source text for GuoFeng/BWB and Chinese reference translations for General Books. The five groups span 4K–64K; the General Books 64K group corresponds to approximately 68K–82K English input tokens. These fixed evaluation sets have also been used during model development. Index-NativeLong uses greedy decoding with a 256K-token context window.
blocks.zh: 主比较评价了原生环境的所有模型:每个模型都收到完整的测试文档,并被要求在单代翻译. 所有测试长度组都使用中方符号计数: GuoFeng/BWB的中文源文本和通用图书的中文参考译本. 5组跨度为4K–64K;通用图书64K组对应约68K–82K英语输入符. 这些固定评价组也被用于模型开发。 Index-NativeLong使用带有256K-token上下文窗口的贪婪解码.

blocks.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash is excluded from the main comparison because its 65,536-token output limit [ 29 ] falls below the 128K output budget reserved for the longest test group. North’s long-input results use an experimental extension beyond its supported 16K input/output range. Some GLM requests are refused; the affected results are marked in Table 12 .
blocks.zh: 双子座 3.8 Flash被排除在主比较之外,因为它的65,536个托肯输出极限[29]低于为最长的测试组预留的128K输出预算. 北方的长期投入结果使用了超出其支持的16K投入/产出范围的试验扩展。 表12列出了一些GLM申请被拒绝;受影响的结果。

blocks.en: We use SEGALE [ 24 ] to align the generated translation with the source before applying COMET [ 25 ] . The output is segmented into sentences, and semantic alignment matches contiguous source and output blocks. Each matched output block is paired with its source text and the corresponding reference translation, allowing sentence-level COMET to evaluate long documents despite differing sentence boundaries. Unmatched blocks receive zero. We average block scores within each document, then document scores within each length group, and finally weight the five groups equally per corpus.
blocks.zh: 我们使用SEGALE [24] 在应用彗星 [25] 之前将生成的译文与来源对齐 。 输出被分割成句子,语义对齐匹配毗连源块和输出块. 每个匹配的输出块都与其源文本和相应的参考翻译对齐,使得句子级的Comet尽管句子界限不同,但仍可以评价长文件. 未匹配的块得到零。 我们在每个文件中的平均积分,然后在每个长度组中的文件积分,最后对五个组进行平均加权。

blocks.en: Index-NativeLong supports the full tested length range and achieves strong quality under native generation. The 9B model has the highest five-group means in Table 12 on GuoFeng, BWB, and General Books: 0.7891, 0.7683, and 0.8848. Several models score similarly on short passages, but their quality diverges as length increases (Figure 4 ). On GuoFeng, Qwen3.8 Flash falls from 0.7974 at 4K to 0.4939 at 64K, while Index-NativeLong-9B changes from 0.7836 to 0.7382. The 2B model also exceeds the external models at 32K and 64K on BWB. These results show that compact models adapted through document training can outperform existing translation and frontier models on native long-document translation.
blocks.zh: Index-NativeLong支持全测试长度范围,并在本土一代下实现强质量. 9B型机车在GuoFeng,BWB,和General Books上的表12中拥有最高的五组表示:0.7891,0.7683和0.8848. 一些模型在短段上得分类似,但其质量随着长度的增加而有所不同(图4 )。 于郭丰,Q文3.8 Flash从4K的0.7974下降到64K的0.4939,而Index-NativeLong-9B则从0.7836变为0.7382. 2B型同样超过了BWB上的32K和64K的外部型号. 这些结果表明,通过文件培训而改编的紧凑模型能够比本地长文件翻译的现有翻译和前沿模型有所改进。

blocks.en: The outputs reveal different failure modes. Hy-MT2 sometimes stops after a short fragment; North can degenerate into repetition without stopping on long inputs; Flash can leave sentences unfinished or retain source-language text. Some 2B outputs repeat passages, possibly reflecting the limits of model capacity during sustained generation.
blocks.zh: 输出显示不同的失败模式 。 Hy-MT2有时会在短片片断后停止;North可以退化为重复而不停止长片输入;Flash可以留下句子未完成或保留源语言文本. 大约2B产出重复段落,可能反映了模型在持续生成过程中的局限性。

blocks.en: Table 12: Native long-document translation with document-SEGALE/COMET ( max_size=8 ). Mean equally weights the five Chinese-side length groups. Bold marks the highest displayed score in each column. ∗ Some GLM samples were refused; its General Books scores average the remaining samples.
blocks.zh: 表12:带有SEGALE/COMET文档的原生长文件翻译(最大_大小=8)。 平均对5个中方长度组进行同等加权。 粗体标出每个列中显示的最高分数. 页:1 一些GLM样本被拒绝;其General Books的分数平均为剩余样本.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Native long-document translation across Chinese-side length groups, reproducing the point estimates in Table 12 . Higher document-SEGALE/COMET is better; unmatched blocks receive zero, so the score reflects coverage as well as translation quality. ∗ GLM’s General Books scores average non-refused samples. North uses the experimental context extension described in Section 4.6 .
blocks.zh: 图4:全中方长度组的原生长文件翻译,转载表12中的点估计. 更高的文档-SEGALE/COMET更好;未匹配的块得到零,因此分数既反映了翻译质量,也反映了覆盖面. * GLM的总书评分平均为未重复的样本。 North使用第4.6节描述的实验上下文扩展.

blocks.en: 5 Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 分析

blocks.en: 5.1 Mid-training design and language coverage
blocks.zh: 5.1 中期培训设计和语言覆盖面

blocks.en: The pilot studies explore data balance and parallel organization using greedy decoding. We use G G for general text, M M for independently sampled monolingual text, P P for ordinary parallel data, and V V for pivot-organized data.
blocks.zh: 试点研究利用贪婪的解码探索数据平衡和平行组织. 我们使用G G作为一般文本,使用M M作为独立抽样的单一语言文本,使用P P作为普通平行数据,使用V V作为枢轴数据。

blocks.en: For the mixture and stage-progression studies, translation scores are the equal-weight mean of direction-level COMET scores across FLORES-200 and WMT24++. The 11-task NLU score is the macro-average over MMMLU, Belebele, M3Exam, XCOPA, XCODAH, XCSQA, XStoryCloze, XWinogrande, M_ARC, MGSM, and INCLUDE, covering multilingual knowledge, reading comprehension, commonsense, and reasoning.
blocks.zh: 对于混合物和阶段进化研究,翻译分数是FLORES-200和WMT24++之间方向级彗星分数的等重平均值. 11任务 NLU分数是MMLU,Belebele,M3Exam,XCOPA,XCODAH,XCSQA,XStoryCloze,XWinogrande,M_ARC,MGSM,和INCLUDE的宏观平均分数,涵盖多语种知识,阅读理解,常识,推理.

blocks.en: The balanced G : M : P = 1 : 1 : 1 G{:}M{:}P=1{:}1{:}1 constant mixture gives the highest translation score among eight candidates and ties for the highest NLU score (Table 13 ). This pilot supports retaining both monolingual and parallel data. Decay-stage translation scores are closely grouped across mixtures; additional settings appear in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 平衡的G:M:P=1 = 1 = 1 G{:}M{:}P=1 {:}1{:}1 =}1 恒定的混合物给8名考生提供了最高的翻译分数和NLU最高分数的领带(表13). 这一试点支持保留单一语言和平行数据。 衰竭阶段的翻译分数在混合物之间进行了紧密的组合;其他设置载于附录A.2。

blocks.en: In the Qwen3-8B pilot on 20 core languages, pivot-only and P : V = 1 : 2 P{:}V=1{:}2 training achieve similar translation and NLU scores at the same 25.17B-token decay budget (Table 13 ).
blocks.zh: 在20种核心语言的Qwen3-8B试点中,只偏转和P:V=1:2 P{:} V=1{:}2训练在相同的25.17B-token衰变预算(表13)上实现了类似的翻译和NLU分数.

blocks.en: Table 13: Selected mid-training pilots, using the metrics defined in Section 5.1 . The organization pilot uses Qwen3-8B with a 16K context; both runs reach step 10,000 at the same decay budget. Bold marks panel maxima.
blocks.zh: 表13:使用第5.1节中界定的衡量标准选定的中等培训试点。 组织试点采用16K上下文的Qune3-8B;两者在相同的衰变预算下运行达到1万步. 粗体标记面板最大。

blocks.en: Translation improves through both the constant and decay stages at 2B and 9B in the 20+-language development study (Table 14 ). General-task NLU drops during the constant stage and partially recovers during decay, remaining below the base-model score at both sizes.
blocks.zh: 在20+语言发展研究(表14)中,翻译在2B和9B的常数和衰变阶段都有改进。 一般任务NLU在恒定阶段会下降,在衰变时会部分恢复,在两种大小都保持在基模分数以下.

blocks.en: Table 14: Training-stage progression in the 20+-language development study, using the metrics defined in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh: 表14:使用第5.1节界定的衡量标准,20+语言发展研究的培训阶段进展。

blocks.en: Expanding the 2B decay data from 20+ to 100+ languages improves the non-core mean from 0.5605 to 0.6570, with an approximately unchanged core-language mean (Table 15 ). All 61 non-core target languages improve, and their off-target rate falls from 1.94% to 0.89%.
blocks.zh: 将2B衰变数据从20+语言扩展至100+语言,使非核心平均值从0.5605提高到0.6570,核心语言平均值大致不变(表15). 所有61种非核心目标语言都有所改善,其非目标比率从1.94%降至0.89%。

blocks.en: Table 15: Language expansion at the mid-training stage on 81 target languages. Corrected COMET averages English- and Chinese-source directions per target, assigning zero to off-target outputs.
blocks.zh: 表15:81种目标语言中级培训阶段的语言扩展。 校正的彗星指向每个目标的英文和中文源方向平均值,将零分配给非目标产出。

blocks.en: In a 22-language-only SFT control, 60-language FLORES-200 COMET falls from 0.7441 to 0.7062 between steps 200 and 400, and target-language agreement falls from 59.22% to 40.02%, while core-language scores remain nearly unchanged. This failure motivates retaining low-resource directions during SFT and evaluating language coverage beyond the core set.
blocks.zh: 在只使用22种语言的SFT控制中,60种语言的FLORES-200 Comet从200步到400步的0.7441下降到0.7062步,目标语言协议从59.22%下降到40.02%,而核心语言的分数几乎没有变化. 这一失败促使在SFT期间保留低资源方向,并评价核心组合以外的语文覆盖面。

blocks.en: 5.2 Specialist training and integration
blocks.zh: 5.2 专家培训和融合

blocks.en: Table 16 compares each specialist before and after RL. For the Instruction expert, instTrans quality improves by 0.0386 and IFscore by 0.0934, with gains on IFMTBench and low-resource instructions. For the General expert, low-resource FLORES COMET-22 improves by 0.0236 and off-target rate falls from 3.4% to 1.2%. FLORES XCOMET-XXL and both WMT24++ metrics improve, while FLORES COMET-22 decreases by 0.0017. These results show stronger instruction adherence and low-resource translation after RL, with metric-dependent changes on core-language translation.
blocks.zh: 表16比较了每个专家在康复前后的情况。 对于指令专家来说,Instrans的质量提高了0.0386,IFscore提高了0.0934,在IFMT Bench和低资源指令上取得了收益. 就一般专家而言,低资源FLORES COMET-22改进0.0236,非目标率从3.4%下降到1.2%。 FLORES XCOMET-XXL和WMT24++两个度量衡都有改进,而FLORES Comet-22则减少了0.0017. 这些结果显示,在RL之后,对指令的遵守程度更强,资源翻译也更低,核心语言翻译的变化取决于衡量标准。

blocks.en: Table 16: SFT-to-RL changes for the 9B Instruction and General specialists before model integration. Each RL model is compared with its own SFT baseline. Instruction evaluation uses GPT-5.6-Sol. Score differences are absolute; off-target changes are percentage points (pp), where lower is better.
blocks.zh: 表16:9B指令和一般专家在模型整合前的SFT到RL变化. 每个RL模型都与自己的SFT基线进行对比. 指令评价使用GPT-5.6-Sol. 分数差异是绝对的;非目标变化是百分点(pp),其中较低。

blocks.en:
These ablations use an earlier instruction-expert configuration at the same interpolation weights; the main results use the updated instruction specialist. Instruction scores use GPT-5.6-Sol.
The reference blend improves FLORES and WMT XCOMET-XXL at both sizes, while IFMTBench IFscore declines relative to the general parent; MEME improves at 2B and decreases slightly at 9B (Table 17 ). A separate 2B, 20-language weight scan supports retaining a dominant general branch: reducing its weight from 1.0 to 0.5 raises WMT XCOMET-XXL from 0.8222 to 0.8522 but lowers IFscore from 0.7395 to 0.2828.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion Index-Translate is a multilingual translation model family that combines multilingual mid-training and specialist integration for general translation and instruction following across 150 languages. Our experiments highlight the importance of broad language coverage and the trade-offs between translation quality and constraint adherence. Index-Echo, Index-Homura, and Index-NativeLong extend the shared foundation through dedicated training for speech, syllable control, and native long-document translation.
blocks.zh: 6 《结论索引-翻译》是一个多语种翻译模式家庭,将多语种中级培训与专家集成,按照150种语言进行一般翻译和教学。 我们的实验突出了广泛的语言覆盖面的重要性以及翻译质量与遵守约束之间的权衡。 Index-Echo、Index-Homura和Index-NativeLong通过语音、音节控制和本地长文件翻译的专门培训,扩大了共同的基础。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Index-Translate is a multilingual translation model family that combines multilingual mid-training and specialist integration for general translation and instruction following across 150 languages. Index-Echo, Index-Homura, and Index-NativeLong extend the shared foundation through dedicated training for speech, syllable control, and native long-document translation.

blocks.en: With matched short document SFT, using prepacked 128K rather than 4K sequences during mid-training decay improves mean quality by 0.0528 with RoPE [ 11 ] and 0.0495 with NoPE (no explicit positional encoding) [ 10 ] . The 128K route uses exponential learning-rate decay under WSD.

blocks.en: After document SFT covering source lengths up to approximately 64K, the two 128K-decay bases have similar overall scores: approximately 0.7810 for RoPE and 0.7819 for NoPE. Their strengths vary by length, with NoPE ahead at 16K and RoPE ahead at 64K. When document SFT is limited to source texts of approximately 16K or less, NoPE scores higher over the 4K–32K evaluation range, with a 0.0370 advantage at 32K.
blocks.zh: 在文件SFT覆盖源长度达约64K之后,两个128K-decay基座的总体得分相似:ROPE约为0.7810,NoPE约为0.7819. 他们的长处因长度而异,无PE在16K领先,ROPE在64K领先. 当文档SFT仅限于约16K或以下的源文本时,NoPE的得分高于4K–32K的评价范围,在32K有0.0370的优势.

blocks.en: B.6 IFMTBench preprocessing and scoring
blocks.zh: B.6 IFMT Bench 预处理和评分

blocks.en: The original IFMTBench contains 7,344 examples: 4,506 single-constraint and 2,838 combined-constraint items [ 15 ] . Our evaluation uses a cleaned subset of 7,064 examples (4,226 single-constraint and 2,838 combined-constraint items), after removing 280 single-constraint examples with data-quality issues. These include corrupted reference text, where unassigned or private-use code points replace or interrupt ordinary words, and inconsistencies between language labels and the source or reference language. The reported instruction-following aggregate averages 7,063 valid judgments; one retained example did not yield a valid judgment. This scoring omission is separate from the 280 preprocessing exclusions.
blocks.zh: 原IFMT Bench包含7,344个实例:4,506个单约束项和2,838个组合约束项[15]. 我们的评价采用了一个由7 064个实例组成的清理子集(4 226个单一约束项目和2 838个合并约束项目),删除了280个带有数据质量问题的单一约束项目实例。 其中包括被腐蚀的参考文本,未指定或私用代码点替换或中断普通词,以及语言标签与源语言或参考语言不一致. 报告的指令跟踪汇总平均数为7 063项有效判决;一个保留的例子没有得出有效判决。 这一积分遗漏与280项预处理排除无关.

blocks.en: For combined constraints, hard checks gate the mean graded constraint score. The reported IFscore is the sample-level mean over valid judgments, rather than a weighted combination of separate single- and combined-constraint means. Reference-based XCOMET-XXL measures translation quality separately and is not combined with IFscore.
blocks.zh: 对于综合约束,硬检查门 平均等级约束分。 所报告的IFscore是抽样一级的平均值,而不是有效的判断,而不是单独的单一和合并约束手段的加权组合。 基于参考的XCOMET-XXL测量翻译质量,不与IFscore结合.
